real_defects.issue: EU/UK phthalate row (REACH Annex XVII entry 51) was limited to children's products, but Regulation (EU) 2018/2005 extended entry 51 to plasticised material in articles generally from 7 July 2020 (retained in GB law), so an adult tee with plastisol prints for the EU or UK got no phthalate test. Reproduced: testPlan({product:'adult-apparel',markets:['eu','uk'],features:['plastisol']}) had no eu-phthalate row. Fixed: row applies to all apparel, names the four phthalates and the amending regulation; test added.

GB_PER_TIB was 1024 (GiB per TiB) while the page, README and FAQ tell users to enter GB as AVG(total_bytes_billed)/1e9 and the guardrail multiplies GB by 1e9; BigQuery bills per TiB (2^40 bytes), so every on-demand cost, TiB total, share and per-run price was 7.4% too high (2^40/1e9/1024 = 1.0737). Reproduced: analyze(parseQueries('a,1000,1000')).totals.tib was 976.56, not 909.49. Fixed: GB_PER_TIB = 2**40/1e9, tests moved off the 1024 assumption, and the marketing page's '180 GB costs about $1.10 a run' corrected to $1.02.
